SELECT ce.id, ce.parent_id as parentId, ce.owner_no as ownerNo, ce.department, ce.project_id as projectId, ce.created_by as createdBy, CASE WHEN ce.scope = 'PROJECT' AND e.name IS NOT NULL THEN ce.title || ' (' || e.name || ')' ELSE ce.title END as title, ce.description, ce.starts_at as startsAt, ce.ends_at as endsAt, ce.is_all_day as isAllDay, ce.scope, ce.google_event_id as googleEventId, ce.color_type as colorId, ce.recurrence_rule as recurrenceRule, ce.recurrence_count as count, e.name as ownerName, d.name as departmentName, p.name as projectName FROM calendar_event ce LEFT JOIN employee e ON ce.owner_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN departments d ON ce.department = d.code LEFT JOIN project p ON ce.project_id = p.id WHERE ce.scope = #{scope} AND (
ce.owner_no = #{employeeNo}
ce.department = (SELECT department FROM employee WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo})
ce.project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM project_member WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo})
) AND ( ce.project_id IS NULL OR (p.id IS NOT NULL AND p.status NOT IN ('ON_HOLD', 'DONE', 'CANCELED')) )
AND ce.starts_at < CAST(#{end} AS timestamp) AND ce.ends_at > CAST(#{start} AS timestamp)
ORDER BY ce.starts_at ASC

SELECT ce.id, ce.parent_id as parentId, ce.owner_no as ownerNo, ce.department, ce.project_id as projectId, ce.created_by as createdBy, CASE WHEN ce.scope = 'PROJECT' AND e.name IS NOT NULL THEN ce.title || ' (' || e.name || ')' ELSE ce.title END as title, ce.description, ce.starts_at as startsAt, ce.ends_at as endsAt, ce.is_all_day as isAllDay, ce.scope, ce.google_event_id as googleEventId, ce.color_type as colorId, ce.recurrence_rule as recurrenceRule, ce.recurrence_count as count, e.name as ownerName, d.name as departmentName, p.name as projectName FROM calendar_event ce LEFT JOIN employee e ON ce.owner_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN departments d ON ce.department = d.code LEFT JOIN project p ON ce.project_id = p.id WHERE ce.id = #{id}
SELECT department FROM employee WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo}
